style_prefix: Cartoon cell-shaded illustration, bold black outlines, flat colors with cel shading, 16:9, storybook style. Halloween palette: deep purple night sky, orange pumpkin light, black shadows. Main character: a young man dressed as a vampire, black cape with red lining, pale skin, dark hair, pointed white fangs, friendly cartoon face. Recurring old lady Mrs Morticia: white hair in a bun, long dark dress, pearl necklace, warm smile. Recurring old man Henri: very old, pale translucent skin, elegant old suit, seated in an armchair. Recurring black cat Minou with a small medallion. Spooky old house on a suburban street at night.
style_suffix: Keep exactly the same art style, character designs and color palette as the other panels of this Halloween story.
